```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

fetch_imdb_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  page <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_string() |>
    read_html()

  imdb_table <- page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table() |>
    select(all_of(c("Rank & Title", "IMDb Rating")))

  rank_title_data <- imdb_table |>
    transmute(
      rank_title = str_squish(`Rank & Title`),
      rating = as.numeric(`IMDb Rating`)
    ) |>
    extract(
      rank_title,
      into = c("rank", "title", "year"),
      regex = "^\\s*(\\d+)\\.\\s*(.*?)\\s*\\((\\d{4})\\)\\s*$",
      convert = TRUE
    )

  rating_tooltips <- page |>
    html_elements("td.ratingColumn strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  if (length(rating_tooltips) != nrow(rank_title_data)) {
    stop("The number of rating tooltips does not match the number of table rows.")
  }

  number <- str_match(rating_tooltips, "based on ([0-9,]+) votes")[, 2] |>
    str_remove_all(",") |>
    as.integer()

  rank_title_data |>
    mutate(snap_year = snapshot_year, number = number, .before = rank) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number) |>
    slice_head(n = 250)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snapshot_urls, snapshot_years, fetch_imdb_snapshot) |>
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
rank_change_data <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rank_2015), !is.na(rank_2022)) |>
  mutate(
    decade = floor(year / 10) * 10,
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015
  )

rank_change_data |>
  arrange(desc(abs(rank_change))) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  select(title, year, decade, rank_2015, rank_2022, rank_change)

rank_change_data |>
  group_by(decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(decade)
```

```{r}
average_rank_change <- rank_change_data |>
  group_by(decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      avg_rank_change < 0 ~ "Moved up",
      avg_rank_change > 0 ~ "Moved down",
      TRUE ~ "No average change"
    )
  )

average_rank_change |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = factor(decade), fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Moved up" = "#2C7FB8",
      "Moved down" = "#D95F0E",
      "No average change" = "gray60"
    ),
    name = "Direction"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Negative values indicate films moved up; positive values indicate they moved down.",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 rank - 2015 rank)",
    y = "Release decade",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```

```{r}
film_snapshot_counts <- imdb_snapshots |>
  count(title, name = "snapshot_count")

film_snapshot_counts |>
  count(snapshot_count, name = "film_count") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(snapshot_count), y = film_count)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Number of snapshots a film appears in",
    y = "Number of films"
  )
```
